name: A Deceitful Act
source:
A young man has a wild day that changes the way he looks at things. Relationships are never what they seem. His life is turned upside down one day.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/MrAxxx]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一个年轻人度过了疯狂的一天，这改变了他看待事物的方式。关系从来都不是表面上看起来的那样。他的生活有一天发生了翻天覆地的变化。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/MrAxxx]Patreon[/url]]
